horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.  H Bowman was fined $2,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 250 Metres.
Shortly after the start shifted in and was bumped.  Raced keenly in the early stages and for some distance leaving the 800 Metres was steadied away from HAPPY HORSE.
Slow to begin and then shortly after the start was crowded between HAPPY BOYS and EVER SMART which shifted in slightly.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  In the early stages of the Home Straight was shifted out to obtain clear running and near the 200 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with HAPPY TANGO.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Bumped on jumping.  Over the final 50 Metres could not be ridden out when held up between HAPPY HORSE and CAMP FIRE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Reported by the Veterinary Surgeon to have blood at the left nostril after the race.  An endoscopic examination confirmed the  horse to be a bleeder.  Before being allowed to race again, SANTORINI will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 400 Metres lay in and as a result was steadied to avoid CHEER FOR SOUTH.  Near the 200 Metres was bumped by GENERAL SMART which shifted out.  As a result HAPPY TANGO then could not be ridden out for some distance thereafter when positioned close to SANTORINI.  Trainer Y S Tsui advised the instructions were to take up a more forward position but despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.

Near the 300 Metres lay in towards KINGLY DEMEANOR.  When being corrected to avoid KINGLY DEMEANOR, DOUBLE WIN shifted out and made contact with SHARPEN BRIGHT approaching the 250 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 500 Metres was steadied when crowded between MISSION STRIKE which shifted out slightly and MANAGEMENT FOLKS which was racing tight to the inside of VIVA TASTE which shifted in as it was giving ground.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running.  H Bentley advised that he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages from the outside barrier.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions and said such instructions were issued to offset the outside barrier.
Near the 250 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by DOUBLE WIN.

Jumped only fairly.  After being held up for clear running on the Home Turn was then steadied and shifted to the inside of DOUBLE WIN approaching the 300 Metres to obtain clear running.  Between the 200 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of KINGLY DEMEANOR.
Jumped only fairly.  Crowded near the 500 Metres.

Bumped on jumping.  Z Purton reported that in the Home Straight his mount finished the race off in a one-paced manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

Bumped on jumping.  After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on MISSION STRIKE at the request of Trainer M Newnham.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MISSION STRIKE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

L Ferraris reported that his mount lay in throughout the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a mild abrasion to the left hind leg.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 350 Metres improved to the inside of PERPETUAL POWER and made contact with GOLD TACK.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Leaving the 1600 Metres when being crossed by NINJA DERBY got its head up when racing keenly.  In the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride out.
Shortly after the start was bumped by ROSEWOOD FLEETFOOT which shifted out.

Near the 250 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of COOL BLUE to continue into clear running.  B Avdulla reported that his instructions were to settle where comfortable.  He said after STAR BROSE jumped awkwardly and made contact with WAH MAY WAI WAI it settled further back in the field than he had anticipated.

Near the 350 Metres STORM RUNNER improved to the inside of PERPETUAL POWER when that runner shifted out.  A short distance later PERPETUAL POWER (M Guyon) shifted back in, resulting in STORM RUNNER making slight contact with GOLD TACK and STORM RUNNER then being turned in due to the contact, resulting in GOLD TACK having to be steadied when crowded.  The Stewards were satisfied that Jockey Guyon had endeavoured to correct his mount when it shifted back in.  No action was taken.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1200 Metres was steadied away from SILVER KING.
Bumped at the start.
Bumped at the start.

Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Near the 300  Metres was hampered when being shifted out to avoid PERPETUAL POWER.  J McDonald could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 300 Metres shifted out and away from STORM RUNNER.

Bumped at the start.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  The performance of SILVER KING, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SILVER KING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.  H Bowman was fined $2,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 250 Metres.
Bumped at the start.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Bumped at the start.  L Hewitson stated that the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner but after jumping well it held a more forward position than what had been intended.
No report.

On jumping shifted out and away from PERFECT GENERAL.  For some distance approaching the 250 Metres lay in when racing tight between GIDDY UP and TURIN CHAMPIONS.  COME FAST FAY FAY continued to lay in for the remainder of the event and proved difficult to ride out to the finish.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

On jumping shifted out and made contact with the left side of its starting gate and then shortly after shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of GREAT STATE.  Making the first turn commenced to race keenly and got its head up when positioned close to CALIFORNIA DEEPLY.  VIGOR ELLEEGANT continued to race keenly in the middle stages.  Making the Home Turn was held up for clear running behind SPEEDY TRIDENT.  After the 300 Metres VIGOR ELLEEGANT had some difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SPEEDY TRIDENT.  Passing the 150  Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of CALIFORNIA DEEPLY to continue into clear running.
J McDonald could offer no explanation for his mount’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up for clear running between CALIFORNIA DEEPLY and GREAT STATE which was giving ground.

Bumped on the hindquarters at the start.  M Chadwick reported that after enjoying a comfortable run during the race his mount did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight and would derive a fitness benefit from tonight’s experience.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the first turn near the 1000 Metres, when racing keenly, got its head up when crowded by KING GLORIOSO (L Ferraris) which shifted in when not clear before being corrected by Jockey Ferraris.  Jockey Ferraris was reprimanded and advised in the circumstances he should correct his mounts sooner than what he did.  After being crossed by KING GLORIOSO near the 1000 Metres then continued to race keenly and approaching the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid KING GLORIOSO.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start and became unbalanced.  Near the 1000 Metres was bumped by SWAGGER BRO and taken wider.  Near the 250 Metres was shifted to the outside of CALL TO COMMAND to obtain clear running.  Between the 200 Metres and the 150 Metres then raced tight between REWARDING BUDDY and CALL TO COMMAND which shifted out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Approaching the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of CALL TO COMMAND to obtain clear running and made contact with IMPENDING LEGACY.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When being shifted behind GENIUS BABY approaching the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid GENIUS BABY when SWAGGER BRO shifted out to avoid LEGENDARY IMPACT.  Near the 200 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of SWAGGER BRO and LEGENDARY IMPACT to obtain clear running.  M Guyon was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.

Shortly after the start shifted out, made contact with GENIUS BABY and became unbalanced.  Near the 1000 Metres blundered after making contact with GENIUS BABY.  Near the 150 Metres blundered.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M L Yeung advised that from the outside barrier his instructions were to go forward.  Trainer C W Chang confirmed the instructions issued.
No report.
On jumping was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.
Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Apprentice E C W Wong could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer C Fownes could offer no excuse for the performance and advised that he will now spell the horse as he was of the view that it had reached the end of its preparation.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start bumped with GENIUS BABY and became unbalanced.  A short distance later BASIC INSTINCT was then steadied when crowded between GENIUS BABY and MASTER RESOLUTE which shifted in slightly.

Near the 250 Metres was steadied when crowded between CALL TO COMMAND (M L Yeung) which shifted in slightly and SILVER SPURS (Apprentice E C W Wong) which shifted out.  Apprentice Wong was reprimanded and advised he must stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear.  M L Yeung was advised to exercise more care.

On jumping made contact with the hindquarters of BRAVE WIN.  Near the 300 Metres was bumped by REWARDING BUDDY (K C Leung) when that runner was shifted to the outside of CALL TO COMMAND to obtain clear running.  K C Leung was advised to exercise more care.
On jumping became unbalanced when crowded between ONE LOVE and JUICY DRAGON, both of which shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start was bumped by CIRCUIT DUFFY, became unbalanced, shifted out and made contact with ONE LOVE which shifted in.  After being shifted to the inside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ near the 250 Metres then lay in for some distance thereafter.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  L Ferraris was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.
Jumped only fairly.  When commencing to finish the race off well approaching the 50 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ to continue into clear running.

Shifted in at the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.  Near the 50 Metres became unbalanced when it was crowded between ACE POWER and LUNAR DASH which shifted out.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.

Z Purton stated that near the 150 Metres his mount became unbalanced when it shifted out and away from CALIFORNIA BLITZ.  He added that LUNAR DASH then continued to shift out over the final 100 Metres and near the 50 Metres made contact with JUICY DRAGON as he corrected his mount.  Trainer M Newnham stated that LUNAR DASH may not have been suited by being ridden in a forward position tonight and at its next start he will instruct the rider to ride the horse in a more conservative manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

On jumping shifted out and made contact with CALIFORNIA BLITZ.  A short distance later ONE LOVE shifted in and made contact with KNOW AT HEART.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the middle stages raced keenly when awkwardly positioned between I AM BACK and ACE POWER.
On jumping shifted in and made contact with SUPER UNIVERSAL.  A short distance later CIRCUIT DUFFY shifted out and became unbalanced when it made contact with KNOW AT HEART.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER UNIVERSAL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped shortly after the start.  When questioned about the improved performance Trainer P C Ng stated that at its last start the horse was disadvantaged by drawing a wide barrier and not running out a strong 1200 Metres.  He added that tonight BLUE ILLUSION was advantaged by drawing towards the inside and dropping back in distance to 1000 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Making the first turn near the 600 Metres hung out and as a result made contact with SIX THREE WIN.  LOVE TOGETHER then continued to hang out making the turns in the middle stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out shortly after the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.  Near the 850 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by DEVAS TWELVE which lay in and away from PARENTS’ LOVE despite the efforts of its rider.  Bumped near the 600 Metres.  Lay in in the Home Straight, resulting in its rider M Guyon changing his whip through to his right hand after the 150 Metres.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out to the finish when held up between BLUE ILLUSION and LOVE TOGETHER.

Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  After being crossed by PARENTS’ LOVE approaching the 600 Metres commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being steadied away from PARENTS’ LOVE.  As a result ETERNAL FORTUNE shifted out and made contact with WONDERSTAR.  Trainer C S Shum stated that, in his opinion, ETERNAL FORTUNE may not have performed to expectation tonight after having a hard run on 2 November 2025.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded by LOVE TOGETHER which shifted in and away from DEVAS TWELVE despites the efforts of its rider.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind WONDERSTAR.
Crowded shortly after the start.

Y L Chung stated that he had made too much use of his mount in the early stages to lead and as a consequence the horse was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Crowded shortly after the start.  Passing the 500 Metres raced tight to the inside of SUPERB KING which was racing tight to the inside of DEVAS TWELVE.
M Chadwick stated that throughout the event his mount lay in and near the 850 Metres shifted away from PARENTS’ LOVE and became unbalanced when it made contact with WONDERSTAR.

Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between LUCKY XANDER which was taken out by WONDERSTAR and RYUI KOKOROE which was racing tight to the inside of CELESTIAL HERO which was crowded by LOVE TOGETHER.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Making the turn near the 600 Metres was hampered and taken wider when bumped by LOVE TOGETHER.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Bumped approaching the finish.  H Bowman reported that his mount made a respiratory noise during the running of the race.  Before being allowed to race again, STAR CONTACT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the finish shifted out slightly and made contact with STAR CONTACT.

Bumped at the start.  M Chadwick reported that his mount lay in, particularly when under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when it improved behind STAR CONTACT.  C Y Ho reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but despite being ridden along in the early stages his mount did not show sufficient pace to do so.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced keenly in the early stages.

Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  K Teetan stated that his mount was disadvantaged by settling back in the field with the early stages of the race being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 150 Metres was steadied when crowded between S J TOURBILLON which was racing tight to the inside of FALLON and TALENTS TRUMP which shifted out before being corrected by its rider D Probert.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly.  Near the 450 Metres was steadied when awkwardly placed close to MONDIAL when that runner lost ground.  When giving ground near the 150 Metres shifted out and made contact with AESTHETICISM when being corrected by its rider.
Near the 150 Metres was crowded.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again
